questions.title: BufferedReader Role
questions.description: Java offers several I/O classes for reading text files. Which class wraps around a FileReader to add internal buffering and provides the readLine() method that returns one full line at a time?

questions.title: FileWriter Append Flag
questions.description: A program opens an existing file and writes to it. The file data.txt already contains exactly the text 'old data'. Study the snippet and decide what data.txt contains after it runs.
questions.Option1: old dataentry one (the new text is appended after the old text)
questions.Option2: entry one (the old content is erased)
questions.Option3: old data (the new text is discarded)
questions.Option4: entry oneold data (new text is written before the old text)

questions.title: readLine At End Of File
questions.description: A student loops over a text file with BufferedReader as shown. What makes this loop terminate correctly when the file runs out of lines?
questions.Option1: readLine() returns an empty string at end of file
questions.Option2: readLine() throws IOException at end of file
questions.Option3: readLine() returns null at end of file, so the loop condition fails
questions.Option4: readLine() returns the word EOF at end of file

questions.title: Checked IOException Rule
questions.description: java.io.IOException is a checked exception. What does the Java compiler require from code that calls file methods which can throw it?
questions.Option1: The call must sit in a try block with a matching catch, or the enclosing method must declare it with throws
questions.Option2: Nothing special, because IOException is unchecked
questions.Option3: The class must extend IOException to handle it
questions.Option4: The call is allowed only inside constructors

questions.title: Serializable Marker Interface
questions.description: java.io.Serializable is usually called a marker interface. What does that mean?
questions.Option1: It is an abstract class with one abstract method to override
questions.Option2: It declares no methods; it only marks a class as eligible for object serialization
questions.Option3: It provides a default writeObject implementation
questions.Option4: It automatically encrypts every field of the class

questions.title: PrintWriter Close Discipline
questions.description: A PrintWriter collects characters in an internal buffer before they reach the disk. A program writes ten lines with println but exits without calling close() or flush(). What is the most likely result?
questions.Option1: The JVM crashes with an IOException on exit
questions.Option2: The file grows to twice its expected size
questions.Option3: Java flushes the buffer automatically after every println, so the file is complete
questions.Option4: Some or all buffered lines may never reach the file, leaving it empty or incomplete

questions.title: File delete Return Value
questions.description: The File class models a file path and offers file operations. What does f.delete() return when called on a File object?
questions.Option1: A boolean that is true when the file was successfully deleted
questions.Option2: Nothing; it throws an exception when deletion fails
questions.Option3: The name of the deleted file as a String
questions.Option4: An int with the number of bytes freed

questions.title: Truncating Write Constructor
questions.description: A program must replace the entire content of data.txt with new text. Which constructor opens the file for writing and discards any previous content?

questions.title: ObjectInputStream Read Type
questions.description: After saving an object with ObjectOutputStream.writeObject, a program reads it back with ObjectInputStream.readObject. What does readObject return, and what must the calling code do?
questions.Option1: It returns the exact original class, so no cast is needed
questions.Option2: It returns a String description of the object
questions.Option3: It returns Object, so the code must cast it back to the original class
questions.Option4: It returns void and fills a field of the stream

questions.title: Which Fields Are Skipped
questions.description: A class implements java.io.Serializable and one of its objects is written with ObjectOutputStream. Which kind of field is NOT stored in the file?
